evidence: 5 types: adopter number, document, number, placeholder, missing.
human_reason: The form accepts adopter number or document in the same field.
treatment: Separate type and value; use adopter_id when available.

human_reason: Free-text field and copy/paste between rows.
treatment: Normalise to E.164 and separate mobile/landline.

issue: Status differences between Adoptions and final
evidence: 6 of 12 overlapping IDs differ; 4 are progressions and 2 are reversals.
human_reason: Follow-up updates after calls; Adoptions does not revise, and later decisions are appended.
treatment: Status per team + timestamp, not a single mutable field.
Store a full timestamp with year and timezone.

evidence: 60 in Scoring, 13 in Summary and 10 in Sheet3.
human_reason: File distributed and read outside Excel; not recalculated.
treatment: Do not read KPIs from formulas; recompute in the pipeline.

evidence: 10 records with dob_clean different from dd/mm/yyyy; 1016 is confirmed by 1023, so the raw entry is mm/dd.
human_reason: The form asks for dd/mm/yyyy, but entries and Excel locale mix dd/mm and mm/dd.
treatment: Explicit parsing with dayfirst=True, plus a cross-record audit before using DOB as a key.

human_reason: Current list, updated after contact; not all placements have follow-up.
treatment: Status and date fields per contact; distinguish not applicable from unknown.

issue: Cross-team linkage almost absent by phone
evidence: 2 of 14 Follow-up adopters have an exact phone in Adoptions; deterministic name/status rules resolve 10, leaving 1 ambiguous.
human_reason: Different, shared or hastily entered phones; Follow-up records only an abbreviated name.
treatment: Add an application/person ID to the Follow-up export; keep a human-review seam for the residual.

evidence: 13 Status categories, including blank, for 8 canonical statuses.
human_reason: Fast entry during the campaign, with no closed list.
Row insertion/removal and copy/paste across campaigns.
treatment: Fixed IDs, validation and key-based formulas, not positional ones.

evidence: 1006 does not exist; 1012 exists only in final; 1016 and 1023 are the same person.
human_reason: Rows deleted/inserted between campaigns, parallel lists and re-submitted requests.
treatment: Immutable person/application IDs and an event log by source.

issue: Same person appears in two application rows
evidence: 1016 and 1023 Mark Shaw share adopter no. 060064440, phone 07570 468615 and DOB 1985-10-02.
human_reason: The form invites a second submission to correct a request; a re-application creates a new row.
treatment: person_id + application_id; allow several applications per person and resolve to one person.

issue: final includes a record absent from Responses
evidence: 1012 Sophie Webb exists only in final.
human_reason: Record created directly in the final list.
treatment: Event model with source and timestamp; reconcile by name.

evidence: DOG-0424 is the same Lola offered to Danielle H. (not collected) and then Harry A. (waitlist); DOG-0418 becomes DOG-0421.
human_reason: Fallback reservation and animal swap during the trial; not duplicate placements.
treatment: placement_id + status history, not just animal_code.

evidence: 3 adopters have no candidate in Adoptions.
human_reason: They may be from another cohort, another centre, or have different names.
treatment: Confirm the list's scope before assuming records are missing.

issue: Test rows in the production base
human_reason: The team tests the form in the live sheet.
treatment: is_test flag; exclude from KPIs without deleting.

human_reason: Reviewers' internal convention; not a universal key.
treatment: Preserve, document and do not use as a linkage key.

evidence: The 'Home visit' formula counts the 'visit' status; there are 16 visits with a score.
human_reason: Old formula inherited from previous campaigns.
treatment: Separate scheduled visit, completed visit and outcome.

evidence: Responses has groups in row 1 and field names in row 2; dob_clean is a helper.
human_reason: Sheet copied and adapted across campaigns.
treatment: Dedicated loader; preserve the original file.
